Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) Construction There are several methods available for constructing a SVO. This implementation uses the one described in Ch. 22 of OpenGL Insight, with minor modification. Several steps are needed for this SVO construction method: Build a voxel fragment list. Build the SVO, level by level, using the voxel fragment list.
